title: Customer support contact details leaking into checkout-service logs
description: A routine log audit found that the checkout-service error handler is logging full customer-support ticket payloads verbatim into centralized logging, instead of the sanitized summary the schema expects. Escalation contact for this incident: sarah.connor@retailcorp.com, reachable at +1-415-555-0187. A sample of the leaked payload (see raw_logs below) also shows a card number captured verbatim in a log line, which must be scrubbed from the logging pipeline and from any downstream report before this incident can be closed.
raw_logs: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T11:04:41.000Z","sequence":501,"loggerClassName":"org.slf4j.impl.Slf4jLogger","loggerName":"com.mockcorp.commerce.checkoutservice.support.TicketPayloadLogger","level":"ERROR","message":"unsanitized support payload logged verbatim: contact=sarah.connor@retailcorp.com phone=+1-415-555-0187 card=4111 1111 1111 1111","threadName":"support-ingest-2","threadId":19,"mdc":{"affiliate_code":"001"},"processName":"/work/quarkus/application","processId":1,"IMAGE_TAG":"3.2.0","region":"us-east-1","environment":"production"}

raw_events.description: Rolled out checkout-service v3.2.0 (added verbose support-ticket payload logging for debugging, not yet reviewed for PII exposure)

metadata.guardrail_note: The description and raw_logs both embed an email address, a phone number, and a test credit-card number (the industry-standard 4111 1111 1111 1111 test Visa number, not a real card) so the PII guardrail (app/guardrails/pii_guard.py) flags this incident at ingestion, and the notification-email renderer's PII redaction (app/services/email_report_renderer.py) is exercised if the description text ever flows into the final report.
